intent.raw_query: Costa Rica eco-adventure, $2500, zip-lining and wildlife, February from Miami

experiences.name: Monteverde Cloud Forest Zip-Line Canopy Tour
experiences.description: Soar through the misty cloud forest canopy on one of Costa Rica's most iconic zip-line circuits. With over 13 cables, Tarzan swings, and suspension bridges, this adrenaline-packed experience offers breathtaking views of the forest and occasional wildlife sightings including toucans and howler monkeys.

experiences.name: Tortuguero National Park Wildlife Boat Safari
experiences.description: Glide through the jungle canals of Tortuguero on a guided boat safari teeming with wildlife. Spot caimans, river turtles, three-toed sloths, poison dart frogs, and over 300 bird species. Between July and October, witness the awe-inspiring nesting of green sea turtles on the beach at night.

experiences.name: Arenal Volcano Hanging Bridges & Rainforest Hike
experiences.description: Walk among the treetops on a network of hanging bridges and forest trails surrounding the iconic Arenal Volcano. This self-guided or guided eco-walk reveals incredible biodiversity including morpho butterflies, coatis, and resplendent quetzals, with stunning volcano views throughout.

experiences.name: Manuel Antonio National Park Guided Wildlife Tour
experiences.description: Explore Costa Rica's most beloved national park with a certified naturalist guide who uses high-powered telescopes to reveal hidden wildlife. Encounter all four monkey species, two-toed sloths, iguanas, and vibrant tropical birds, then relax on the park's pristine white-sand beaches surrounded by jungle.

experiences.name: Corcovado National Park Day Trek
experiences.description: Venture into one of the most biodiverse places on Earth with a guided day trek through Corcovado's primary rainforest. Home to tapirs, scarlet macaws, white-lipped peccaries, and all six wild cat species in Costa Rica, this raw and remote jungle experience is the ultimate eco-adventure for serious wildlife enthusiasts.
